Scans critical kinds for *_ref / *_refs targets that do not exist and removes

them via storage Update (kernel.cas_object_update). Does not mint fake

historical IDs. Defaults to dry-run; pass --apply to write.

  Preview unlinks
  zqk system kernel-integrity heal-dangling
  Apply unlinks
  zqk system kernel-integrity heal-dangling --apply

Usage:
  zqk system kernel-integrity heal-dangling [flags]

Flags:
      --apply              Apply unlink updates (implies dry-run=false)
      --dry-run            Report only; do not write (default true)
  -f, --format string      Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --limit int          Max dangling hits to consider (0 = unlimited)
  -o, --output string      Write output to file
  -q, --quiet              Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration   Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose            Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
